hero.lead: A nation of 2.1 million with forest across six tenths of its land, a €2.08 billion EU recovery and resilience plan, and growth of 3.2% projected by the IMF this year.

capital.heading: Green and growing, and every drop treated.

register.name: Public rental housing construction, 2027 and 2028
register.detail: Government of Slovenia · spending plan adopted 12 March 2026 · €150M to the Housing Fund of the Republic of Slovenia and €50M to SID Bank · 2,524 public rental and supported rental dwellings in progress at the Housing Fund
register.note: SID Bank lends to municipalities, public housing funds and non-profit housing organisations at a 1% fixed rate over 30 years, under a mechanism signed with the ministry on 10 March 2026
register.text: Funds the government has made available for housing construction in 2027 and 2028. The Housing Fund of the Republic of Slovenia acquires public rental dwellings through its own construction, purchase or work with local partners, and SID Bank finances public rental housing built by others. It serves the shelter standard.
by: Housing Fund of the Republic of Slovenia

register.name: Three-year social Samurai bond
register.detail: Ministry of Finance · priced 7 November 2025 · coupon 1.24% · TONA mid-swaps + 20 bp · demand of nearly JPY 50bn · swapped into euros (EUR 175M) · 57:43 split between Japanese and international investors
register.note: Issued under the Sustainability Bond Framework, with a second-party opinion from Morningstar Sustainalytics of January 2023
register.text: A social bond of the Republic of Slovenia sold in the Japanese market, whose proceeds are used exclusively to finance or refinance eligible social projects under the Sustainability Bond Framework. The Ministry’s releases do not name the social categories, so no one of the seven standards is named.

register.name: Ten-year sustainability-linked bond
register.detail: Ministry of Finance · priced 24 June 2025 · matures 2 July 2035 · coupon 3.125% · yield 3.155% · mid-swaps + 61 bp · books above €6.5bn
register.note: The first sovereign sustainability-linked bond in Europe; the coupon rises by 50 bp from the ninth year if emissions do not fall 35% from 2005 by 2030, and falls by 50 bp if they fall 45%
register.text: A bond whose proceeds may be used without restriction, while the Republic commits to cut total greenhouse gas emissions by 2030 under the Sustainability-linked Bond Framework published in March 2025. It funds the budget as a whole; no one of the seven standards is named.

register.name: Recovery and resilience plan
register.detail: European Union · €1.61bn in grants and €469M in loans after the fifth amendment (April 2026) · sixth amendment approved 10 July 2026 · €1.81bn received by 31 July 2026 · final payment request of €271.77M submitted 29 September 2026
register.note: 86.9% of the available funds received by 31 July 2026; €1.7 billion paid to final recipients
register.text: EU grants and loans for 36 reforms and 49 investments across five pillars, tied to 182 milestones and targets. Its measures include flood risk reduction, educational infrastructure, the electricity distribution network and emergency medical vehicles, serving the shelter, education, energy and health standards.

register.name: Social and affordable housing, SID Bank
register.detail: European Investment Bank · intermediated framework loan · project 20250692 · signed 22 July 2026 · total cost €300M · backed by a statutory State guarantee of SID Bank’s obligations
register.note: Matched by a €150 million CEB loan; lent on at a 1% fixed rate over 30 years
register.text: An EIB loan to SID Bank, the Slovenian export and development bank, to finance rental social housing across Slovenia, with new dwellings and the deep refurbishment of ageing stock under regulated rents. It serves the shelter standard by improving the availability of adequate public rental housing.

register.name: Social and Affordable Housing Facility, SID Bank
register.detail: Council of Europe Development Bank · programme loan approved 16 March 2026 · on-lending to public and non-profit housing entities and municipalities
register.note: About 1,200 housing units and 3,000 citizens expected to benefit
register.text: A CEB loan to SID Bank for public and non-profit housing providers and municipalities to build, renovate and convert housing, expand the public rental stock and improve its energy performance. It serves the shelter standard for low-income households, young families, older people, persons with disabilities and households at risk of housing exclusion.

register.name: Energy poverty reduction programme 2024–2027, Eco Fund
register.detail: European Regional Development Fund · EU cohesion policy 2021–2027, priority “Green transformation for climate neutrality” · announced 29 May 2025 · total value €32.94M · implemented by Eko sklad, the Eco Fund
register.text: EU cohesion funding for energy-efficiency and renewable-energy investments in energy-poor households, with advice, behaviour-change measures and coordinators who identify and guide eligible households. It serves the energy standard for households in energy poverty.

register.name: Municipal infrastructure in Slovenia, SID Bank
register.detail: Council of Europe Development Bank · programme loan approved 5 April 2025 · co-financing of municipal investments across Slovenia · the fourth CEB loan to SID Bank for housing activities
register.note: Also responds to disaster-recovery needs after the severe floods of 2023
register.text: A CEB loan to SID Bank to co-finance municipal infrastructure across Slovenia, including social and affordable housing for low-to-middle-income households and other vulnerable groups. It serves the shelter standard and supports recovery after the floods of 2023.

register.name: EU Solidarity Fund, floods of August 2023
register.detail: European Union · advance of €100M paid 11 December 2023 · balance of €328.4M received 9 December 2024 · implementation period ended 9 June 2026
register.note: The implementation report is due within six months of the end of the implementation period
register.text: EU grant aid for emergency and recovery operations after the floods of August 2023, which caused nearly three billion euros in direct damage. Eligible operations include restoring energy, water supply and wastewater, healthcare and education facilities, and temporary housing, serving the energy, water, shelter, health and education standards.

assets.heading: Five assets no balance sheet counts.

items.name: The Forest
items.label: Of the land under forest, 2024
items.text: Standing forest that stores carbon and water, and can earn as it stands.

items.name: The Fresh Water
items.label: Renewable fresh water a person, 2022
items.text: Rain and rivers renewed every year: power, irrigation and drinking water.

items.name: The People
items.label: Citizens, 2025
items.text: 14.5% are under fifteen: the workforce and the market of the next generation.

items.name: The Clean Grid
items.label: Of electricity from renewable sources, 2021
items.text: Power from water, wind and sun already flows; every new connection can be clean.

items.name: The Farmland
items.label: Of the land in agriculture, 2023
items.text: Land that can feed the nation and earn abroad, valued and financed against its harvest.

items.name: Center ponovne uporabe (CPU)
items.text: The social enterprise that launched Slovenia’s first reuse centre, which collects, prepares and resells furniture and mattresses at four locations and in 2025 had 36 full-time roles, over half of them on work-integration contracts for people who face barriers in the labour market.

items.name: Korenika eco-social farm (Pribinovina)
items.text: An eco-social farm in Šalovci, in the Goričko Landscape Park, that grows crops, herbs, fruit and vegetables on some twenty hectares and processes them into organic products, employing disabled people and people from other vulnerable groups.

items.name: Mozaik – društvo za socialno vključenost
items.text: An association with social enterprise status in Murska Sobota that has worked since 2003 to meet the needs of vulnerable social groups in Pomurje, and ensures their inclusion by developing social entrepreneurship.

items.name: EPEKA
items.text: An association with social enterprise status in Maribor, with its own online store and reservation platform, that runs an employment rehabilitation service in 2024 and 2025 for people with disabilities who need support to develop their work abilities and skills.

items.name: Društvo Verjamem vate
items.text: A social enterprise in Domžale dedicated to including people with physical and intellectual disabilities in work environments, selected by the Employment Service of Slovenia in December 2025 to employ a person from its Učne delavnice+ training workshops.

items.name: Zavod VITICA
items.text: A social enterprise in Gornja Radgona that provides home help to families, selected by the Employment Service of Slovenia in December 2025 to employ a person from its Učne delavnice+ training workshops.
